label: Higher-block recoding
title: What does the higher-block recoding cost, and what does it leave alone?
kind: Exact audit of a declared local recoding with locality budget
summary: The 2-block recoding, forward radius 1 and inverse radius 0, leaves the minimum cap radius unchanged in 665 of 674 decided cells and reduces it by one in 9, never more; derivative and commutator transport componentwise; derivative closure is preserved; the Research026 observer family is closed under complement and reversal, so that census is covariant by deduction.
takeaway: A 2-block recoding is nearly free in cap radius and invisible to closure and the commutator. Two constructions that differ by it should not count as different primitives.
